newsitem.title: NORWAY: TABLE - NORWAY'S JULY CPI RISES 2.2 PCT MNTH/MNTH.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - NORWAY'S JULY CPI RISES 2.2 PCT MNTH/MNTH.

text.p: Statistics Norway (SSB) issued the following economic indicator.
NORWAY CONSUMER PRICES JULY 1997 JUNE 1997 JULY 1996
NOTE -- Ten economists polled by Reuters forecast Norway's July CPI to rise by an average 2.52 percent year-on-year and to increase by 0.04 percent from June.

Statistics Norway attributed the month-on-month fall to lower electricity prices and summer discounts on clothes. It said that the smaller year-on-year increase in July compared with June was due to the annual settlement between farmers and the government, a change in subsidies on agricultural products and lower electricity prices.
